info.title: ShareSomething API
info.description: Self-hosted sharing of text, links, credentials and files with per-share security

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only records with `seq` below this (pagination cursor from `next_before`).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action, or a prefix ending in `.` such as `auth.` or `share.`.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Actor label (email/identity) or id, exact match.

get.summary: Export matching records (oldest first) as JSON lines (ECS) or CSV. The export itself is audited.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only records with `seq` below this (pagination cursor from `next_before`).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action, or a prefix ending in `.` such as `auth.` or `share.`.

parameters.name: actor
parameters.description: Actor label (email/identity) or id, exact match.

get.summary: Delivery status of each configured SIEM shipper.
Re-verify the hash chain of the whole audit trail.

post.summary: Sign in with a password (+ TOTP when enabled).
Sign out and invalidate the current session.
Finish a passkey sign-in; the new session counts as freshly MFA-verified.
Begin a passkey sign-in (replaces password + TOTP).
Finish registering a passkey.
Begin registering a new passkey. Needs a fresh MFA when TOTP or another passkey exists.
Finish a passkey MFA step-up.
Begin a passkey MFA step-up for the current session.

delete.summary: Remove one of your passkeys. Needs a fresh MFA.

post.summary: Re-confirm TOTP to open shares that require fresh owner MFA.

delete.summary: Turn off the authenticator app. Refused if it would leave "require owner MFA" shares unopenable.

post.summary: Confirm the new authenticator with a code from it; replaces any previous TOTP secret.
Start (re)configuring the authenticator app. Needs a fresh MFA if a second factor exists.
Save a policy under a name; saving an existing name replaces it.

delete.summary: Delete a saved policy (shares that used it keep their own copy of the rules).

post.summary:
Ask for a one-time code by email. Always answers the same way, whether or not a code was
actually sent, so it can't be used to discover which addresses have access.
Confirm an emailed code; on success the email is added to the visitor's identities.
Forget all of the visitor's identities.

get.summary: Provider redirects back here; on success the verified email(s) join the visitor's identities.
Start signing in with a provider (redirects to it).

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Path to return to after signing in, e.g. `/s/my-share`.

get.summary: What a visitor needs to do to open a share. Unknown, expired and burned shares all return 404.

Download chunk `n` of file `idx` with the token from a successful open.
E2E shares return ciphertext (decrypt in the browser); server shares return plaintext.

post.summary:
Server-mode only: decrypt and stream a whole file straight into the browser's download
manager (submitted as a form, so nothing is buffered in page memory).
Open a share: consumes one view and returns the content.
Create a share.

delete.summary: Permanently delete a share (its audit records are kept).

patch.summary: Change a share's title, limits or policy, or revoke it.

put.summary:
Upload chunk `n` of file `idx`. Chunks of a file must be sent in order; re-sending a chunk
replaces it and everything after it.

post.summary: Mark a file share's upload as complete; it becomes openable.

get.summary: Access log for a share, newest first.
Enabled link generators and their options.

post.summary: Generate an example link without reserving it.

AccessLogEntry.description: One line of a share's activity log (a view of the audit records targeting the share).

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next (older) page.

credential.description: The credential returned by the browser, binary fields base64url-encoded.

ciphertext.description: E2E mode: base64 ciphertext (nonce || AES-GCM ciphertext of the payload JSON).

enc_meta.description: E2E mode: client encryption metadata (algorithm, KDF params, wrapped key).

files.description: File shares: plaintext size of each file, in manifest order. Upload chunks afterwards.

max_views.description: Destroy after this many successful opens (1 = read once).

passphrase.description: Server mode: optional passphrase mixed into the key.

passphrase_verifier.description: E2E mode with passphrase: base64 verifier derived from the passphrase.

redirect_secs.description: Link shares: open the target automatically after showing it for this many seconds (0-60).

upload_token.description: File shares: send as `x-upload-token` with every chunk and with finalize.

secret.description: Masked until revealed in the UI.

slug.description: The share being opened; a code is only sent if this email could get access to it.

chunk_size.description: Plaintext bytes per chunk (the last chunk may be shorter).

user_supplied.description: The slug text itself comes from the user (e.g. vanity slugs) rather than randomness.

email.description: Team mode: the account's email. Single mode: omit.
Team mode: whose passkey. Single mode: omit.

mfa_valid_until.description: Unix time until which the last MFA (TOTP or passkey) satisfies "require owner MFA" shares.

passkeys.description: Registered passkeys (same scoping as `totp_enabled`); passkey sign-in is offered when > 0.

totp_enabled.description: TOTP state of the signed-in user (single mode: of the owner, so the login form can ask for it).

burned.description: True when this open used the last view and the content has been destroyed.

ciphertext.description: E2E mode: base64 ciphertext to decrypt in the browser.

download_token.description: File shares: send as `x-download-token` to fetch chunks (valid until `download_expires_at`).

default.description: Pre-filled value (empty = the user must type one).

Record.description: A stored audit record, as hashed, queried and shipped.

details.description: JSON object (stored as text so the hashed bytes are exactly what's stored).

name.description: Label shown in the passkey list, e.g. "Laptop".

oneOf.description: Client IP within any of these networks (CIDR or bare IP, v4/v6).
Client country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), from a trusted Cloudflare header.

Verified email address. `methods` restricts how it is verified
(`email_otp`, `oidc:<provider>`); empty allows any configured method.
Any verified address at one of these domains.

ShareInfo.description: What a visitor learns before opening a share. Details are hidden unless access is allowed.

auth_methods.description: Acceptable sign-in methods when `status = need_auth` (empty = any).

kdf.description: E2E: KDF parameters the browser needs to derive the passphrase verifier.

redirect_secs.description:
Link shares: open the target after this many seconds. The page may also open the share
without a Reveal click, but only when it has no view limit and no passphrase.

oneOf.description: Manifest of a file share; file contents are fetched separately in chunks.

SharePayload.description: Decrypted share content. For E2E shares the browser encrypts exactly this JSON.

redirect_secs.description: Link shares: auto-redirect delay in seconds.

upload_pending.description: File share whose upload hasn't been finalised yet; not openable.

url.description: Link without any E2E key fragment.

generator.description: Generator id from `GET /api/slug-generators`; defaults to the configured default.

name.description: File name for the browser's save dialog.

token.description: Download token from the open response.

qr_svg.description: QR code as an SVG data URL.

redirect_secs.description: Link shares: seconds before auto-redirect (0-60); -1 turns redirecting off.

revoke.description: Revoke now: content is wiped immediately.

first_bad_seq.description: First record whose hash or link doesn't match.
